system_prompt_style.note: Prompts are customizable via docs, but the evidence does not show how the system prompt is built.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Shallow research agent**: Bounded tool-augmented research optimized for speed
env_context_strategy.note: Research agents call search and retrieval tools (Tavily, knowledge layer RAG). Retrieval happens through tools the model invokes, not through prompt injection. The value list fits a research agent poorly.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Treat any bring-your-own model or modified profile as an experimental customization until the complete workflow is evaluated with that exact model, prompt, hyperparameter, tool-calling, and structured-output
tool_call_format.note: Inferred from the tool-calling references and the LangChain/Deep Agents base. The parser is not shown.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: AI-Q is focused on governed research workflows; it is not a general-purpose coding-agent harness.
edit_primitive.note: The only file writing shown is to the virtual /shared/ filesystem. No repo edit tool is shown.

tool_schema_source.note: The source of the schemas for the native tools is not shown.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Expose AI-Q to MCP clients through the standalone, stateless Streamable HTTP server

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Advisory source routing, structured planning, concurrent researcher workers, bounded source-tool batching, and a dedicated writer produce citation-backed reports
loop_primitives.note: Uses a LangGraph state machine. Shallow research is a single tool-calling loop.

human_in_loop.note: A Human-in-the-Loop doc page exists, but its content is not in the evidence. A clarifier agent gathers context before research.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for intent classification and shallow research in the default profiles

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:

shared research state remain in the AI-Q process.
execution_isolation.note: Code execution through an optional Modal or OpenShell sandbox is opt-in. Code falls closest to in-process (the none value).

tracing.note: Phoenix tracing is optional. The OpenTelemetry export mechanism is not explicit in the evidence.
